description: The output guard v4 eval set (ADR 0160, design section 3c). v3-probe: the 232 adversarial strings (206 replies A-E, 26 phone formats M) and the 81 ordinary replies (L) of the third review round (w3-core-recheck3); 9 ordinary rows wrote a placeholder after a name, v3 style, and stand here in their v4 form (v3Text keeps the original; the v3 forms are the v4-placement rows). earlier-rounds: the rows of the earlier review rounds' tables. layer = the layer that must stop an adversarial row: deterministic rows are asserted by test/assistant/guard.test.ts, judge rows are what W4 measures against Bedrock (pnpm eval:guard).
